title: MÉDICO SAÚDE DA FAMÍLIA - AP 4.0
description:
Descrição da vaga

A Estratégia Saúde da Família consiste em uma reorientação do modelo assistencial, realizada mediante a implantação de equipes multiprofissionais em Clínicas de Saúde da Família. Estas equipes ficam responsáveis pelo acompanhamento de um número definido de famílias de áreas geográficas delimitadas, atuando com ações de prevenção e promoção à saúde dessa comunidade.

As equipes da ESF são compostas por Médico Generalista ou Médico de Família e Comunidade, Enfermeiro, Auxiliar ou Técnico de Enfermagem e Agentes Comunitários de Saúde (ACS).

Também há equipe de Saúde Bucal, composta por cirurgião-dentista generalista ou especialista em saúde da família, auxiliar e/ou técnico em Saúde Bucal.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Realizar atendimento na Estratégia Saúde da Família, conforme as diretrizes da Secretaria Municipal da Saúde e protocolos existentes. Realizar assistência à população sob o âmbito da promoção e proteção da saúde, prevenção de agravos, diagnóstico, tratamento, reabilitação e manutenção da saúde individual, coletiva e incluindo ações no domicilio. Realizar interface com a Rede Assistencial à Saúde, atuando de forma integral na coordenação do cuidado, através de ações que facilitem o acesso, integralidade, longitudinalidade, resolutividade e a participação da comunidade nos Serviços de Saúde.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Desejável experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Médico.

Local de trabalho: AP 4.0 (Jacarepaguá, Barra da Tijuca, Recreio e adjacências)

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Basic Function

Reporting to the Assistant Vice President of Multimedia & Digital Communications, in the Office of University Communications, the Videographer/Multimedia Specialist is responsible for planning, directing, and conducting video and photo shoots both in studio and on location. The role involves capturing content related to Howard University leadership, campus events, activities, and meetings. The position also entails producing storytelling content that aligns with the University’s brand identity and supports its reputation. Strong storytelling abilities, technical proficiency, and photography skills are required to create various types of digital and long‑form video content to address institutional objectives.

Supervisory Accountability

Supervises student interns as needed. No other accountabilities are projected in this role.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include faculty, staff, administrators, students and University leadership. External contacts include vendors, partners, and alumni.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Develops visual/audiovisual/still photography strategies to support the brand identity of Howard University.
  • Collaborates with Office of University Communications (OUC) team members to conceptualize and plan video solutions to meet institutional goals and objectives.
  • Attends and contributes to regular meetings within the Office of University Communications.
  • Works collaboratively with digital content producers across the University, including faculty, staff, and students.
  • Plans, directs, and executes video and photo shoots in studio and on location.
  • Demonstrates the ability to handle all phases of assigned projects from concept through final delivery.
  • Demonstrates strong photography skills for an adaptive environment when photography needs are required.
  • Edits and color grades projects using non‑linear software such as Adobe Lightroom, Premiere, etc.
  • Engages approved freelance support as needed.
  • Independently provides stylized, creative content within the University’s brand guidelines.
  • Grasp of best practices for accessibility, captioning, and SRT files.
  • Communicates effectively with staff and internal and external stakeholders to ensure effective, relevant and timely completion of assignments.
  • Research and provides advice on the latest industry‑related practices and technologies.
  • Transports equipment and/or travel to locations via personal vehicle or University transportation to assignments.
  • Manages and catalogues content in the internal digital asset management system.
  • Conducts routine equipment maintenance.
  • Successfully manages multiple projects.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Experience with directing on‑camera talent, participants, or personalities is a strong plus.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to work in various positions on a production crew.
  • Strength in creativity, organization, attention to detail, and ability to function as part of a team independently with specific or ambiguous direction.
  • Experience using Canon ecosystem a plus.
  • Strong production and post‑production skills.
  • Knowledge of current and emerging trends in social media, generative AI, AI workflows, streaming platforms, and digital video marketing is a big plus.
  • Experience capturing both portrait‑style content and live event coverage is a strong plus.
  • Experience setting up and managing audio for video productions.
  • Some familiarity with generative AI production workflows, including but not limited to Midjourney, KIng, Suno, Google Labs (Veo/Flow, etc), and other emerging tools. Ability to integrate these technologies into storytelling, ideation, and post‑production pipelines is a major plus.
  • Ability to consistently meet deadlines, successfully multi‑task, and work within established brand/product guidelines.
  • Computer proficient and proficient in non‑linear editing, Adobe Premiere, Adobe After Effects, and related software.
  • Proficient in visual production and design software, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and Adobe Lightroom.
  • General administrative software programs including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, FTP clients, general internet search, and research skills.
  • Strong drive and initiative. Self‑motivated.
  • Media file management and organization and understanding of multiple digital media formats, codecs, and containers.
  • Strong communication skills.
  • Animation skills are a plus but not required.
  • Understands the power of feedback and input on projects.
  • Positive, professional attitude and strong team player.

Minimum Requirements

A bachelor’s degree in photography, film, video production, or a related field. 2 or more years of general production experience, including shooting, interviewing, recording, editing and finished professional quality video media. Ability to work outside of normal business hours, including travel outside of the area.

Expected Salary Range: $65,000 - $72,000

A Eletrobras agora é AXIA Energia e chega como a maior empresa de energia renovável do Hemisfério Sul, responsável por 17% da capacidade de geração nacional e 37% das linhas de transmissão do Sistema Interligado Nacional (SIN).

Com presença em todas as regiões do país, nosso foco é oferecer soluções completas que catalisem resultados, impulsionando o desenvolvimento do setor e transformando energia em oportunidades para pessoas, negócios e para o planeta.

Na AXIA Energia, o futuro é movido pela potência de quem acredita em transformar. Venha viver o novo com a gente!

ATENÇÃO : A AXIA Energia não cobra taxas para realização de testes, exames ou participação no processo seletivo.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver projeto e soluções de indústria 4.0 aplicadas aos Sistemas de Armazenamento de Energia de Bateria (BESS) em escala de rede, elaborando layouts conceituais, diagramas unifilares e apoiando o detalhamento do projeto, desde a arquitetura de controle e proteção até a integração ao sistema de supervisão (SCADA).
  • Definir e validar arquiteturas de comunicação para Sistemas de Armazenamento de Energia em Baterias (BESS), assegurando a interoperabilidade entre os dispositivos e sua integração às plataformas de supervisão e controle. A implementação deve contemplar protocolos industriais consolidados (como Modbus RTU/TCP, CAN, IEC 61850) e soluções orientadas à Internet das Coisas (IoT), incluindo MQTT, bem como interfaces baseadas em serviços web (APIs RESTful), garantindo robustez, escalabilidade e conformidade com requisitos de cibersegurança.
  • Elaborar arquiteturas de rede de sistemas de supervisão em cloud computing AWS, considerando medidas de segurança da informação (VPN e firewall).
  • Estabelecer diretrizes, acompanhar e avaliar ensaios de rotina, testes de fábrica, testes de campo e comissionamento de Sistemas de Armazenamento de Energia de Bateria (BESS) e de todos os equipamentos envolvidos, garantindo o correto funcionamento dentro dos padrões de operação e manutenção.
  • Realizar análise de tecnologias, produtos e fornecedores para Sistemas de Armazenamento de Energia em Baterias (BESS), visando suportar a adoção de soluções inovadoras e a definição de critérios técnicos para qualificação e seleção de possíveis parceiros.
  • Desenvolver relatórios técnicos escritos que transmitam conceitos de armazenamento de energia de bateria, casos de uso e resultados de estudos de viabilidade para o pipeline.
  • Realizar e validar dimensionamento de Sistemas de Armazenamento de Energia em Baterias (BESS), considerando suas funcionalidades e contexto dos projetos.
  • Realizar e validar simulações em software de aplicações envolvendo Sistemas de Armazenamento de Energia em Baterias (BESS).
  • Executar o desenvolvimento de planos de engenharia, especificações técnicas, estimativas de custo e documentos de construção de marcos de projeto para projetos de Sistemas de Armazenamento de Energia em Baterias (BESS).
  • Apoiar pipeline na identificação, definição e implementação de casos de uso para Sistemas de Armazenamento de Energia em Baterias (BESS) em locais centralizados e/ou distribuídos.
  • Dar suporte técnico em todas as fases dos projetos de Sistemas de Armazenamento de Energia em Baterias (BESS), como:
    • Planejamento e acompanhamento de projeto;
    • Elaboração de croquis e projetos preliminares, quando necessário;
    • Desenvolvimento de novos padrões tecnológicos com o objetivo de enriquecer as especificações técnicas;
    • Elaboração e atualização de Especificações Técnicas (ETs), Termo de Referencias e Projetos Básicos;
    • Desenvolvimento de equipamentos, sistemas e fornecedores;
    • Elaboração de Estudos Executivos;
    • Elaboração de parecer técnico sobre equipamentos e sistemas;
    • Testes de Aceite em Fábrica (TAF);
    • Comissionamento e Testes de Aceite em Campo (TAC).

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Graduação em Engenharia Eletrônica, Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia de Automação ou Engenharia Mecatrônica, com registro ativo no CREA.
  • Experiência consolidada em projetos de engenharia elétrica/energética, especialmente em sistemas de armazenamento de energia (BESS).

description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua nos segmentos automotivo e do agronegócio, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac(AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkotruck, uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

description:
O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

SOBRE A VAGA

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Procuramos um(a) Professor(a) de Dança para o infantil. Deve ser uma pessoa com paixão por educação e pelo universo dinâmico da escola, que tenha experiência em escola regular ou bilíngue com planejamento e execução de aulas.

RESPONSABILIDADES

O que você fará:

  • Adquirir conhecimento sobre os programas curriculares utilizados nas séries em que leciona;
  • Trabalhar colaborativamente com outros professores e lideranças da matéria e do segmento, buscando alinhamento e consistência;
  • Planejar as aulas e produzir materiais pedagógicos, levando em conta as individualidades dos alunos;
  • Ministrar aulas de Dança alinhadas com a BNCC e o Material Didático selecionado pela escola (físico ou digital);
  • Utilizar práticas variadas de ensino/aprendizagem, incluindo metodologias ativas, ensino responsivo, avaliação para o aprendizado (Assessment for Learning) e métodos investigativos;
  • Utilizar de forma consistente tecnologias para enriquecer e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Supervisionar alunos em espaços escolares;
  • Substituir professores no mesmo segmento quando solicitado;
  • Mediar relacionamento entre crianças, famílias e escola;
  • Preparar avaliações e comunicar os resultados;
  • Tabular e analisar dados pedagógicos com o intuito de ajustar ensino e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Formatar e alimentar com dados nossa plataforma de acompanhamento de avaliações (iSams) em preparação para relatórios para famílias;
  • Participar de reuniões pedagógicas (incluindo COC) e eventos realizados na escola;
  • Garantir a segurança física e emocional dos alunos, e zelar pelo seu crescimento sócio-emocional (safeguarding).

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

REQUISITOS

O que você precisa ter:

  • Diploma de Licenciatura em Dança;
  • Experiência com infantil;
  • Inglês fluente para ministrar as aulas nesse idioma.

Nossos professores devem ser capazes de/devem ter:

  • Capacidade de trabalhar colaborativamente, em equipe;
  • Paixão pela profissão;
  • Adaptar seu estilo de ensino incorporando feedbacks;
  • Estar sempre em busca de melhorias;
  • Atitude positiva frente a mudanças;
  • Compreensão profunda da matéria lecionada;
  • Estabelecer expectativas claras e esticar metas;
  • Excelente planejamento de aulas e domínio de sala;
  • Habilidade de julgar a efetividade do aprendizado;
  • Comprometimento com o desenvolvimento dos alunos, avaliando os resultados e fornecendo feedback para melhorar seu desempenho;
  • Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais;
  • Espírito colaborativo - desejo de trabalhar como parte de um time;
  • Pós-graduação em andamento ou concluída.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. description:
Careers & University Coordinator (Whole School)

Key responsibilities

Strategic leadership and curriculum development

We are looking for enterprise sales people based in LATAM and fluent in Spanish. Colombia is currently the highest priority.


We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.


Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.


Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.


We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.


In Building Our Sales Team, We Look for Five Things



  • Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems

  • High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence

  • Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes

  • Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions

  • Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers


Ubuntu is already very widely adopted which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with the enterprises in your territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgement as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.


The successful candidate will carry an annual bookings quota within their assigned territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagement, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness, to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.


Location


We are expanding our sales organisation globally and have open roles in every region.


What Your Day Will Look Like



  • Represent the company, its solutions and software, in your territory

  • Build and execute a territory plan to prioritize outreach and prospecting

  • Develop new pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events

  • Close contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets

  • Be mindful and proactive in achieving tactical and strategic objectives

  • Manage customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle

  • Work with field engineers to propose solutions that solve our customers' business problems

  • Work with customer success to identify growth opportunities

  • Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts within Salesforce

  • Establish productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision makers


What We Are Looking For in You



  • Bachelor's level degree, preferably in engineering or computer science

  • Experience of open source technology and solutions

  • Detail oriented with effective follow-up

  • Experience in enterprise software or technology sales planning and execution

  • Track record of achievement in sales targets and new account wins

  • Self-discipline and motivation to be successful in a distributed team

  • Professional written and spoken English, as well as any language that may be appropriate for your target market

  • Ability to travel for customer engagements, industry events and company events


Additional Skills of Interest



  • Specific vertical experience, in particular finance, telco, health, energy, public sector, tech

  • Experience speaking at conferences or industry events


What We Offer You



  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

  • Annual compensation review

  • Recognition rewards

  • Annual holiday leave

  • Maternity and paternity leave

  • Employee Assistance Program

  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events


About Canonical


Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a fully distributed company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.


Equal Opportunity Employment


Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Technical Services Senior Manager
description:
Position Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Technical Services Senior Manager is responsible for the strategic planning, coordination, and delivery of all technical services across tournament venues, ensuring full alignment with FIFA requirements and international standards. The role leads the integration and operational readiness of venue infrastructure services including power systems (grid, overlay, and backup), containment, water and waste, HVAC, and broadcast technical support across stadiums, training sites, and non-competition venues.

The position oversees the planning, execution, and supervision of technical services and infrastructure operations, managing power contractors and key suppliers, coordinating containment planning, and leading stadium technical inspections and independent audits. Working closely with internal teams, Host Cities, Stadium Authorities, service providers, and other stakeholders, the role ensures technical compliance, cross-functional alignment, and delivery excellence while maintaining timelines, budgets, and quality benchmarks.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate closely with key Functional Areas to define, refine, and validate technical services requirements, including power, containment, water and waste, HVAC, and floodlighting, across stadiums, training sites, and non-competition venues.
  • Lead coordination with Host Cities, Stadium Authorities, power contractors, utility providers, and suppliers to ensure seamless planning, integration, and delivery of power solutions.
  • Support and contribute to procurement activities, including preparation of technical inputs for RFPs, participation in tendering processes, technical evaluations, and coordination with contracted suppliers and delivery partners.
  • Oversee the development, implementation, and performance of power infrastructure, including grid, overlay, and backup systems, ensuring alignment with FIFA standards and operational requirements.
  • Manage containment planning and execution, ensuring safe, compliant, and efficient routing for power, broadcast, and other technical services.
  • Monitor progress, quality, and compliance of technical services works, proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and mitigation measures.
  • Coordinate stadium technical inspections, readiness reviews, and independent technical audits, ensuring timely closure of findings and follow-up actions.
  • Ensure full compliance with FIFA technical guidelines and international standards, while balancing operational needs, timelines, budgets, and quality benchmarks.
  • Act as the central technical interface between Functional Areas, suppliers, and external stakeholders, ensuring clear communication, alignment, and decision-making.
  • Support procurement, contracting, and supplier performance management related to power, MEP and technical services, including scope definition and technical evaluation.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by capturing lessons learned and driving standardization and best practices across venues.

Your Profile

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical or engineering field
  • A minimum of 8 years work experience in a technical services related field within Major Events/Sports Organization
  • Experience with Energy / MEP required (e.g. Temporary Power, Ventilation and Cooling, Cabling)
  • Strong technical knowledge in Energy / MEP required (e.g. Temporary Power, Ventilation and Cooling, Cabling, Entertainment)
  • Proficient in MS Office and planning software and online collaboration tools
  • Excellent organizational, coordination, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
  • Availability to travel as needed

title: HR Training Analyst
description:
About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.

Job Purpose

The HR Training & Personnel Logistics Analyst is responsible for ensuring full compliance of offshore personnel with mandatory training requirements, managing training logistics, and maintaining accurate certification records in DRAKE System.

The role also supports HR strategy implementation, training governance, personnel logistics coordination, and operational workforce readiness in alignment with corporate policies and project needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure that all offshore personnel hold valid mandatory training and certifications required for offshore deployment;
  • Coordinate all logistics arrangements for trainings scheduled in the DRAKE System;
  • Maintain strict control and timely updates of training and certification records in DRAKE;
  • Provide HR expertise in developing and implementing training-related policies, processes, and improvement actions according to business needs;
  • Interpret, apply, and uphold corporate policies and legal requirements with strong customer focus and best practices;
  • Apply an integrated approach when managing the employee mandatory training cycle (training matrix, gap analysis, deviation notices, certifications, training providers, and budget control) to effectively support Projects and Operations;
  • Monitor and support the local execution of HR Training policies, procedures, and processes;
  • Assist in managing the training budget, including creation and follow-up of Purchase Requisitions (PRs) for all training-related expenses;
  • Coordinate feedback from personnel regarding training provider performance and recommend improvements to management;
  • Support audits and evaluations of training service providers;
  • Provide operational support to the Personnel Logistics team, including weekend on-call coverage and emergency demands when required;
  • Control operational activities related to personnel departure, mobilization, and allocation.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field;
  • Previous experience in offshore operations, oil & gas, or maritime environment preferred;
  • Experience managing training matrices and certification control systems (DRAKE knowledge is an advantage);
  • Knowledge of Brazilian labor and maritime regulations is desirable;
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities;
  • Proactive profile with strong interface capability between HR and Operations.

Benefits

  • Meal and food allowances;
  • Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, no co-pay);
  • Life Insurance;
  • Annual Bonus;
  • Childcare Allowance.

This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.

title: Project Manager, Senior
description:
Job Description

The Senior Project Manager has overall responsibility for the technical, budget, schedule, administrative and financial execution of individual projects. Has responsibility for financial performance on assigned projects. The position may be assigned to several projects concurrently. It may also be assigned to perform specific marketing-related functions, including the presentation of company qualifications for project opportunities and the preparation of proposals. Projects are typically executed on an independent basis, with assistance from assigned staff, though subject to independent quality assurance and financial/management performance audits.

What You Will Do:

  • Develop budgets, schedules, and profit objectives for assigned projects, within the requirements of contracts and subject to the approval of Regional Management.
  • Take the lead in negotiating budgets, schedules, project terms, and conditions on specific proposal opportunities.
  • Work with Regional Management to establish staffing requirements in support of project execution.
  • Initiate project setup to initiate and maintain project management files for assigned projects.
  • In charge of various tasks necessary to execute project requirements.
  • Provide direction and oversight to various employees that are assigned to projects.
  • Assure projects are executed within approved the d budget and schedule and in accordance with company Quality requirements.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for clients on assigned projects.
  • Participate in marketing the company’s services to client contacts and to new clients as assigned by Regional Management.
  • Assist Regional Management in the evaluation of employee performance, and in identifying employee training and development needs.
  • Assist in training and mentoring of project employees.
  • Assure that invoices are properly prepared in accordance with contractual terms and are issued to clients in a timely manner.
  • Work with Financial Services Group to ensure that payment on outstanding invoices is forthcoming in a timely manner.
  • Prepare and submit time charge records, expense reports, invoice approvals, and collections status notices in a timely manner in accordance with company procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor of Science degree.
  • 10+ years of related experience preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to speak and write English fluently.
  • Ability to organize, plan, monitor, and control project contractual requirements, budgets, schedules, and technical work.
  • Ability to utilize basic personal computer applications, including spreadsheets, word processors, email, and internet browsers.
  • Ability to communicate technical aspects of projects and of work assignments to peers, subordinates, and clients.
  • Ability to direct the execution of complex projects.
  • Ability to obtain a working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Reporting Relationships

Reports directly to Group Manager or Regional Manager for administrative matters. May have individual contributor direct reports.

Working Conditions

Work is primarily sedentary; exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, although some work is performed in the field. Work is non-manual in nature.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer | Investments
description:
Senior Staff Software Engineer | Investments

This position is for an Senior Staff Software Engineerto join theInvestments Business Unit.

Investments Platforms is responsible for the core platforms that model Nubank’s investments business: custody, offer, order management, accounts, settlement and related domains. These platforms are the long‑term home for our investments capabilities and the main path to move away from legacy Invest systems that still handle a large portion of critical flows today. Your mandate is to help design, evolve and execute this environment and comply with regulatory requirements.

About Nubank's Engineering Culture:

We believe in small, empowered teams, a process‑light environment and a culture of ownership, learning and collaboration. Our architecture is platform‑oriented: we build extensible, agnostic business platforms (e.g., payments, banking, investments) that can be reused across products, markets and asset classes. You will be expected to think in terms of platforms first, translating complex investment domains into clean boundaries, contracts and abstractions that product teams can safely build on.

Nubank is also on a company‑wide journey to become an AI‑first company. We expect our senior engineers to be hands‑on with AI tools in their own work, and to help define how AI is used safely and productively in engineering and in products.

What we have to offer:

Own the technical direction of Investments Platforms – the systems that implement Nubank’s investments business model in software (custody, offer, orders, account, settlement and more) and power how we scale investments in Brazil and future markets.

Lead the migration off legacy Invest systems : design and execute strategies to move critical flows into modern Nubank platforms, while we continue operating at scale and meeting regulatory commitments.

Work on a disruptive investments architecture – rethinking how investments should be modeled and operated end‑to‑end, rather than just lifting and shifting existing broker or custodian patterns.

Drive AI usage in a high‑impact domain : help define how we use AI in investments – both in the products we ship and in how we design, build and operate platforms.

Collaborate across the platform ecosystem – working closely with other business and technical platforms such as Payments and Banking, and with product squads that consume Investments Platforms.

Global scope with hybrid flexibility : roles are based in Brazil, in a hybrid‑first model (office presence during the week plus periodic on‑site collaboration with other locations).

Core Qualifications (What We're Looking For)

12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years working on large‑scale platforms or core systems in highly available, transactional environments (finance, payments, core banking, trading, etc.).

Proven track record building and operating business platforms that are extensible, multi‑tenant and domain‑agnostic – e.g., custody, payments, banking, risk or similar – with clear contracts for consuming teams.

Experience leading strategic migrations from legacy to new architectures: co‑existence patterns, strangler approaches, staged rollouts and data migration strategies that keep systems up while flows move off legacy.

Strong foundation in distributed systems and event‑driven architectures: domain modeling, consistency and resiliency strategies, backpressure, observability, SLIs/SLOs and incident learning loops.

Demonstrated platform engineering leadership at scale: defining reference architectures and RFCs, building reusable libraries and tools, setting platform SLAs, and making adoption low‑friction and high‑quality for internal customers.

Comfortable working as a horizontal leader across stakeholders: aligning GMs, PMs, EMs and Staff/Principals on trade‑offs between speed, risk, platform consistency and product goals.

Deep experience mentoring and multiplying senior engineers – raising the bar on architecture, design reviews, documentation and post‑incident retrospectives.

Investments expertise: hands‑on experience with investments platforms (brokerage, custody, order management, funds, fixed income, equities, settlement, risk) and understanding of the Brazilian capital markets landscape.

Platform background: prior work on other platforms (payments, core banking, investments) that shows you can design high‑abstraction, agnostic, extensible platforms and translate complex domains into clean boundaries and APIs.

AI fluency: you are already experimenting with AI in your engineering practice (design exploration, code generation/review, analysis, automation) and are excited to help Nubank push its AI‑first agenda in a pragmatic, safe way.

Language: Portuguese fluency is important; English is a plus rather than a hard requirement. We are open to strong IC8 candidates who can ramp up their English over time, and will trade off language in favor of outstanding technical and leadership fit where it makes sense.

Resilience and ownership mindset: you are energized by ambiguous, high‑stakes scenarios, keep a constructive and optimistic stance, and actively pull teams toward positive cultural change instead of getting stuck in pessimism or only in the micro level.

If you feel interested in these challenges and want to work on a highly engaged and talented team transforming how investments work in Brazil and beyond, this is the place for you!

title: Manager, Non-Competition Sites (Safety & Security)
description:
Manager, Non-Competition Sites (Safety & Security)

Department: Safety & Security

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Manager, Non-Competition Sites (Safety & Security) is responsible for planning, coordinating and overseeing safety and security operations across all official non-competition sites for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. This includes hotels, team base camps, training sites, transport hubs, the International Broadcast Centre (IBC) and other designated locations.

The role ensures that robust physical and staffed security measures are designed and implemented in line with identified risks and FIFA standards. The position leads integrated security planning for team and referee operations outside stadium environments and oversees secure movements between official sites. The Manager provides direct leadership to the Team Security Manager, TSLOs/RSLOs and relevant Venue Safety & Security Managers assigned to non-competition locations, ensuring consistency, compliance and operational excellence across all sites.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the integrated safety and security planning for all official non-competition sites, including hotels, team base camps, training facilities, transport hubs, the IBC and other designated locations
  • Develop scalable security concepts tailored to diverse site types and operational risk profiles, including transport security considerations
  • Plan and oversee robust physical security systems and infrastructure, including perimeters, access control, asset protection, search and screening operations
  • Plan and oversee staffed safety and security measures, including security guards, stewards and other deployed personnel
  • Lead the planning and implementation of team and referee security protocols at non-competition sites, including oversight of secure movements between sites and stadiums
  • Provide direct line management and leadership to the Team Security Manager, TSLOs/RSLOs and designated Venue Safety & Security Managers, ensuring clear reporting lines and operational accountability
  • Coordinate centrally with host cities, public security agencies and site counterparts to ensure integrated planning and consistent operational delivery
  • Collaborate with relevant domestic agencies and FIFA functions (e.g. medical, venue management, transport) to develop integrated emergency response, contingency and crisis management plans
  • Develop and implement standardised policies and procedures to ensure consistent safety and security operations across all non-competition sites
  • Ensure alignment between safety and security services outlined in rental or contractual agreements and the operational delivery model; establish clear audit and performance monitoring mechanisms
  • Manage relationships with security suppliers, conduct readiness activities and monitor performance against contractual obligations and service levels
  • Oversee invoicing and verification processes for safety and security suppliers in coordination with finance and administrative teams
  • Ensure compliance with statutory and organisational instruments and relevant FIFA regulations, including the FIFA Stadium Safety & Security Regulations (where applicable)

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • University degree in security management, public safety, event management, law enforcement or a related field
  • Advanced training in protective security, risk management or operational planning is desirable

Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in safety and security planning and operational delivery, preferably within major sporting events or multi-site environments
  • Proven experience in leading teams and managing personnel in operational environments
  • Demonstrated experience in secure movement planning, team protection or protective security operations
  • Experience working with public security authorities, private security providers and venue operators in Brazil
  • Experience managing supplier contracts and monitoring service delivery

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong leadership and line management capability, with the ability to guide, motivate and oversee multiple operational managers
  • Excellent stakeholder management and coordination skills across diverse site environments
  • Strong organisational and planning skills with attention to detail
  • Ability to manage complex, dynamic operational environments and make decisions under pressure
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including structured reporting
  • Advanced IT proficiency including MS Office suite, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word

Certifications & Requirements

  • Willingness to travel nationally and work extended hours during tournament periods
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (spoken and written) is essential
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

  • Coordenar e qualificar a atuação do iCS na temática de mercado de carbono, acompanhando o processo regulatório, articulando parceiros estratégicos, promovendo alinhamentos técnicos entre mercado regulado e voluntário e apoiando a consolidação de um ecossistema institucional com governança robusta e previsibilidade regulatória.
  • Estruturar e gerir parcerias voltadas ao desenvolvimento e incidência em instrumentos econômicos, fiscais e tributários para a transição climática, incluindo precificação de carbono, mecanismos redistributivos e integração de critérios climáticos ao planejamento econômico.
  • Articular e fortalecer centros de pesquisa, think tanks e organizações estratégicas para ampliar a produção qualificada de análises econômicas sobre clima, assegurando alinhamento técnico, sinergia entre iniciativas apoiadas e foco em impacto regulatório e institucional.
  • Coordenar o acompanhamento técnico de estudos e projetos desenvolvidos por donatários e consultores, garantindo aderência às prioridades estratégicas do eixo, consistência metodológica e potencial de incidência nas políticas públicas.
  • Atuar na mobilização de financiamento verde, apoiando iniciativas que fortaleçam instrumentos financeiros públicos e privados, ampliem a alavancagem de capital para mitigação e adaptação e integrem critérios climáticos ao sistema financeiro e orçamentário.
  • Mapear e engajar atores governamentais, setor privado, sistema de justiça e sociedade civil para promover integração federativa e cooperação multissetorial na agenda de Economia e Clima.
  • Apoiar a definição de posicionamentos institucionais do iCS em debates estratégicos como reforma tributária, instrumentos financeiros públicos, planos de desenvolvimento e políticas econômicas com impacto climático.
  • Facilitar espaços técnicos de diálogo e articulação entre parceiros, promovendo convergência de agendas e construção de consensos qualificados.
  • Avaliar tecnicamente propostas de apoio, gerir o ciclo completo de projetos (aprovação, acompanhamento, monitoramento de resultados e reporte), assegurando alinhamento com os outcomes estratégicos do eixo.
  • Produzir relatórios executivos e notas estratégicas para a Diretoria e financiadores, sistematizando avanços, riscos e oportunidades na agenda de Economia e Clima.
  • Executar outras atividades compatíveis com o cargo, conforme demandas estratégicas do eixo programático.

Requisitos Necessários

  • Ensino superior completo em Economia.
  • Mestrado, doutorado ou especialização relevante em Economia do Clima, Economia Ambiental, Políticas Públicas, Finanças Sustentáveis, Desenvolvimento Econômico ou áreas correlatas.
  • Inglês fluente (leitura, escrita e conversação).
  • Experiência mínima de 8 anos em economia ambiental ou climática, políticas públicas econômicas ou financiamento sustentável.
  • Vivência em gestão de projetos estratégicos, articulação multissetorial e acompanhamento técnico de estudos ou consultorias.
  • Experiência com: contexto do terceiro setor e filantropia, economia do clima, instrumentos econômicos e regulatórios para a transição climática, mercado de carbono, financiamento climático, análise de políticas públicas e gestão de portfólio de projetos.

Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Experiência com processos regulatórios e políticas públicas será considerada diferencial.

O que esperamos de você | Requisitos Comportamentais

  • Responsividade, Dinamismo, agilidade, Atitude propositiva, Iniciativa, Trabalho EM e ENTRE equipes, Comprometimento, Criatividade, Atenção aos detalhes, Comunicação assertiva, Solução de problemas, Orientação para Resultados | Organização, Respeito e tolerância a diversidade

Modelo de Contratação

CLT

SOBRE O ICS (Instituto de Clima e Sociedade)

O Instituto Clima e Sociedade (iCS) é uma organização filantrópica que promove prosperidade, justiça e desenvolvimento de baixo carbono no Brasil. Funcionamos como uma ponte entre financiadores internacionais e nacionais e parceiros locais. Assim, somos parte de uma ampla rede de organizações filantrópicas dedicadas à construção de soluções para a crise climática. O iCS traça planos de ação frente aos problemas climáticos a partir de uma lente social. Por isso, prioriza medidas que, além de reduzir as emissões de gases de efeito estufa (GEE), também gerem melhorias na qualidade de vida para a sociedade, em especial para os mais vulneráveis. A atividade principal do Instituto é dar doações para fomentar projetos e organizações que visem:

  • PROMOVER advocacy, campanhas e comunicação
  • CRIAR espaços de interação entre diversos atores e setores
  • INCENTIVAR o intercâmbio de conhecimento e experiência entre o Brasil e o mundo

Além disso, também nos dedicamos ao engajamento da sociedade com o tema de mudanças climáticas, implementação de projetos próprios e capacitação institucional de organizações da sociedade civil.

description:
Candidate-se rapidamente pelo email:

Nível: Auxiliar

Jornada de trabalho: Presencial, segunda a sexta 07:30 às 16:30 e sábado 08:00 às 12:00

Benefícios: Plano de saúde com Coparticipação, Plano odontológico

Responsabilidades Da Posição

O(a) Recepcionista será o primeiro ponto de contato dos pacientes e famílias na clínica, sendo responsável por proporcionar uma experiência acolhedora, organizada e humanizada desde o momento da chegada até o término do atendimento. Essa pessoa atuará em um ambiente com grande fluxo de pacientes e atendimentos por diversos planos de saúde, e terá papel essencial na organização do fluxo de agendamentos e documentação da clínica.

  • Receber e acolher pacientes e acompanhantes, oferecendo atendimento cordial e empático;
  • Realizar cadastros e atualizações de dados no sistema da clínica, garantindo que todas as informações estejam corretas;
  • Fazer agendamentos, remarcações e confirmações de consultas por telefone, WhatsApp e presencialmente;
  • Orientar sobre documentação, autorizações e guias necessárias para os atendimentos;
  • Conferir guias e autorizações de planos de saúde, encaminhando-as corretamente para o setor de faturamento;
  • Organizar e controlar a agenda dos profissionais, mantendo a comunicação clara entre pacientes e equipe técnica;
  • Apoiar na rotina administrativa da recepção, como controle de presença, emissão de recibos e arquivamento de documentos;
  • Manter o ambiente da recepção organizado e acolhedor, refletindo os valores de cuidado e profissionalismo da clínica.

Requisitos Obrigatórios Para a Posição

  • Ensino médio completo (desejável curso técnico ou superior em andamento em Administração, Psicologia, Fisioterapia ou áreas correlatas);
  • Experiência prévia em recepção de clínica ou hospital, preferencialmente com atendimento a convênios de saúde;
  • Vivência com grande volume de atendimentos e rotina dinâmica;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão clínica ou prontuário eletrônico;
  • Domínio básico do pacote Office (principalmente Excel e Outlook);
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com postura profissional e empática;
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes, garantindo precisão no preenchimento e conferência de guias;
  • Comprometimento com sigilo e ética profissional, respeitando as informações dos pacientes e os protocolos internos.

Sobre a Empresa

A Equitar Therapies é uma clínica de neurodesenvolvimento infantil com sede no Rio de Janeiro, dedicada ao atendimento de pessoas com deficiência ou necessidades especiais, com o objetivo de promover autonomia, qualidade de vida e socialização. Com mais de 40 anos de atuação, a empresa iniciou sua história como consultoria especializada na implementação de programas de hipoterapia em universidades e centros de saúde. Desde 1997, mantém uma sólida parceria com o Jockey Club Brasileiro e, atualmente, está presente em diversas unidades — entre elas, Lagoa, Sociedade Hípica Brasileira e Jacarepaguá. A clínica conta com uma equipe interdisciplinar altamente qualificada, formada por profissionais de áreas como Fisioterapia, Fonoaudiologia, Terapia Ocupacional, Psicologia, Psicopedagogia e Equoterapia. Todos atuam de forma integrada, com foco em um atendimento humanizado, técnico e ético.

Position Overview

POSITION TITLE: Administrative Coordinator
SALARY GRADE: HU-12
JOB CODE: 2404
FLSA STATUS: Exempt
EEO CODE: 05

Accountability

Responsible for orienting and training others, and assigning and reviewing their work. May also be responsible for acting in a “lead” or “senior” capacity over other positions performing essentially the same work, or related technical tasks and reporting to a higher level on a formal basis.

Nature And Scope

Principal internal contacts generally include administrators, faculty, students and staff. External contacts generally include vendors, consultants, visitors and the general public.

Key Responsibilities

  • Control the workflow of the office. Implement office procedures and practices.
  • Perform directives from supervisor to coordinate administrative procedures within department and/or among other offices.
  • Maintain bookkeeping records of revenues and expenditures for department or school. Assign proper budget codes.
  • Prepare requests for travel authorizations, services request, etc.
  • Check records, meet with staff and resolve any differences with accounting.
  • Supervise the scheduling of appointments, meetings and conferences for department heads and/or other department staff and students.
  • Coordinate logistics of all department events and meetings including travel and lodging arrangements, agendas, information packets, parking, amenities, etc. and provide on‑site guidance to visitors and guests for university related events.
  • Record and maintain agenda and minutes from all division, department and faculty meetings and distribute them accordingly.
  • Review catalogs and order office supplies and equipment. Obtain bids and price quotes from vendors, monitor inventory of supplies.
  • Create and manage office filing systems.
  • Receive, open and screen mail for the department.
  • Assist in the completion of grant proposals for the department and divisions within the department.
  • Process paperwork for the hiring of new salaried personnel, and advise them concerning the University’s procedures.
  • Enter personnel and financial documents with related software applications.
  • Perform data analysis of average difficulty using tables, graphs and basic statistics. Submit final reports to department administrators and/or managers.
  • Perform other job‑related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Advanced knowledge of office and administrative practices and principles.
  • Skill in operation of computers, related software applications (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Access). Knowledge of standard office equipment.
  • Knowledge and skill in accounting and budgeting techniques and principles.
  • Ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing with a diverse population. Must be detail oriented and organized.
  • Ability to exercise discretion and ensure a high-level of confidentiality.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, residents, students and the general public.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor's degree in business field – Accounting, Finance, Computer information Systems, Cyber Security, Supply Chain Management, Marketing, Management, Economics and 3-6 years of experience.

Salary Range Disclosure

$45,000-$55,000

Programa de Estágio

A Intertechne Consultores S.A. oferece aos estudantes de Engenharia de Controle e Automação o Programa de Estágio, com período de dois anos que proporciona experiência prática em grandes projetos. Essa vivência permite aplicar conhecimentos universitários, aprender com engenheiros experientes e desenvolver uma formação multidisciplinar. title: Principal Genesys Cloud PS Consultant
description:
Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values-driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989. Miratech has coverage across 5 continents and operates in over 25 countries around the world. Miratech retains nearly 1000 full-time professionals, and our annual growth rate exceeds 25%.

Job Description

We are looking for a Principal Genesys Cloud Professional Services Consultant to join our team and drive the delivery of innovative, enterprise-grade contact center solutions.

In this role, you will lead the design and implementation of advanced multi-channel customer experience platforms, leveraging deep expertise in Genesys Cloud and modern contact center technologies.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical leadership, hands-on delivery experience, and the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, high-quality solutions.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for customers and internal stakeholders, providing expert consultancy on Genesys Cloud solutions.
  • Lead the design and delivery of end-to-end technical solutions, including facilitating workshops, gathering requirements, and producing technical design documentation with stakeholder sign‑off.
  • Analyze complex business and technical challenges to define scalable and effective solution architectures.
  • Own and evolve the technical architecture of Genesys solutions, introducing new technologies and best practices where appropriate.
  • Configure and optimize Genesys Cloud environments to align with changing business and operational needs.
  • Lead the planning and execution of contact center deployments, migrations, and system upgrades.
  • Act as the main escalation and coordination point for Genesys-related matters, collaborating with internal teams and external vendors.
  • Support production readiness activities and ensure smooth transition of contact center solutions into live environments.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands‑on experience supporting and optimizing large, multi‑site, complex contact center environments.
  • Experience in designing, implementing, and supporting Genesys Cloud solutions in enterprise settings.
  • Proven expertise in building routing strategies and IVR workflows using Genesys Architect.
  • Experience with CRM integration (e.g., Salesforce, MS Dynamics) with the Genesys Cloud environment.
  • Strong background in infrastructure planning, solution design, deployment, and lifecycle management to ensure high availability and performance.
  • Solid understanding of business processes and their alignment with customer experience technologies.
  • Deep knowledge of SIP infrastructure, including SIP protocol, Session Border Controllers (SBC), and load balancing approaches.

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of Genesys Cloud Workforce Management (WFM): provide expert guidance and best practices to optimize workforce management processes within the Genesys Cloud environment.
  • Genesys Cloud Training: conduct training sessions for various roles, including supervisors, administrators, users, and architects, to enhance their understanding and effective use of Genesys Cloud features.
  • Experience with CX Cloud from Genesys and Salesforce.

Additional Information

We offer:

  • Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, and a relocation program.
  • Work From Anywhere Culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work.
  • Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
  • Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
  • Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team‑building company social events.
  • Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

title: General Manager, International Athletics
description:
Our Mission

International athletes face an uphill battle when trying to recruit to top US universities. The process is opaque, confusing, and stacked against those without access to specialized guidance. Crimson Education changed the game for international students applying to elite universities—we've helped thousands reach Harvard, Stanford, Oxford, Cambridge, and beyond. We're now doing the same for international student‑athletes. Over the past decade, we've built International Athletics into a global business serving athletes across 25+ countries. After years of steady growth, we've recently hit our stride—our service delivery is excellent and results are strong. Now we need someone to take the reins and scale aggressively.

The Opportunity

As General Manager, you'll run International Athletics like the CEO of your own company—but with the resources and safety net of a larger organization. You won't be grinding for every lead like a pure startup, but you will need to build our marketing presence, enable sales teams globally as well as close deals yourself, and drive strong growth.

What You'll Do

Own the Unit End-to-End

  • Set strategy, make decisions, and own revenue outcomes
  • Work closely with our Head of Marketing (Athletics) to build campaigns and accelerate growth
  • Oversee a small team of strategists who deliver service to student‑athletes
  • Partner with country managers across 25+ markets to scale sales

Drive Revenue Growth

  • Enable local sales teams globally to sell Athletics packages effectively
  • Lead athletics sales consultations where your recruiting experience is the credibility driver
  • Build our Instagram, website, and marketing presence
  • Identify expansion opportunities through partnerships, new markets, or service improvements

Manage Service & Team

  • Ensure consistently excellent outcomes for student‑athletes
  • Manage full‑time and part‑time strategists
  • Recruit and build the team as we scale, with support from our recruitment team
  • Work with other product GMs at Crimson who are navigating similar challenges

Navigate the Matrix

  • Coordinate with local sales and marketing teams who primarily sell Crimson's core services
  • Build trust and alignment across a global, remote organization
  • Prove ROI and earn resources through strong performance

Required

  • You recruited as an international athlete to a top US or UK university.
  • Strong sales or business development skills—you've closed deals and hit targets
  • Self‑directed and entrepreneurial—you figure things out and drive outcomes
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, complexity, and moving quickly
  • Genuinely excited about helping international student‑athletes
  • Comfortable working remotely (we're a global, distributed team)

Preferred

  • Experience managing teams or working in matrix organizations
  • Current or recent role in athletics recruiting, coaching, or advising
  • Track record at a high‑growth company or startup
  • Located in a timezone that allows calls with Asia, Australia, and North America

title: Online Pre-IGCSE Science
description:
Want to revolutionize the future of education and do meaningful work that transforms future generations’ lives?

Our team is looking to bring on passionate educators to support our growing student base through part-time teaching roles. This position offers the opportunity to teach bright, motivated students from around the world while maintaining flexibility in your schedule. You'll play a key role in delivering high-quality, personalized learning experiences as we continue to expand our reach globally.

Must be available to teach 1 or 2 hours per week on a Wednesday 1pm - 6pm AEST (Brisbane timezone).

Job Summary

Join our global team as an online teacher for Pre-IGCSE Science and immerse yourself in a premium one-on-one teaching environment. This flexible, remote role empowers you to create tailored learning experiences that meet each student's unique needs, all from the comfort of your own home and on a schedule that fits your lifestyle. With full access to our comprehensive teaching resources, you'll deliver Pre- IGCSE Level curricula, making a meaningful impact on students' educational journeys while enjoying the balance and freedom of remote teaching.

Must be available to teach in the Australian/ New Zealand timezone, we have a lot of demand for this space so hours can be flexible.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver personalized, high-quality instruction in a one-on-one virtual setting, adapting to each student's unique learning needs.
  • Utilize diverse teaching strategies and digital tools to create an engaging and supportive learning environment.
  • Assess student progress, provide targeted feedback, and adjust teaching methods to ensure optimal learning outcomes.
  • Plan and execute clear course schedules, detailing session content and assessment timelines.
  • Conduct professional, interactive live sessions, leveraging online learning resources to enhance the educational experience.
  • Set relevant homework, design and administer assessments, and provide constructive feedback to encourage student growth.
  • Develop educational materials, including tests and exams, contributing to CGA’s rich resource library.
  • Efficiently manage your online classroom on Canvas, keeping it organized with assignments and assessments for easy student access.

Required Qualifications

  • A minimum of 5 years of teaching at this level in a school setting.
  • Please note, while valuable, we are unable to count tutoring experience towards this requirement.
  • A Bachelor’s degree or higher in the subject area you will be teaching.
  • Exceptional communication skills for effective interaction with students, parents, and the CGA team.
  • Familiarity with online teaching platforms and a passion for innovative education methods.
  • Knowledge of the Cambridge, Edexcel or A-Levels curricula and examinations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Teaching qualification such as postgraduate certificate in education, degree in teaching, teaching license
  • Online teaching experience

About Crimson Global Academy

Experiência em funções de liderança no setor de AB (Alimentos e Bebidas).

title: 3D Art Generalist - Brookhaven
description:
Voldex is a leading gaming company focused on Roblox, the most exciting ecosystem in gaming today. We are home to several of Roblox's top games, including Brookhaven, Driving Empire, and NFL Universe Football. With over 160 million monthly active players across our games, we are the #1 Roblox developer by audience size. Founded in 2015, we have since grown to 85+ full-time remote team members across the globe.

Our strategy is to acquire and sustainably grow games on Roblox. Our acquisition strategy is backed with significant capital from firms including The Raine Group, Makers Fund, Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), QIA, Dune Ventures, and MIT.

Role Overview

At Voldex, we build and scale some of the largest games on Roblox. Brookhaven is one of the most popular experiences on the platform, played by millions of players around the world every day.

We’re looking for a 3D Art Generalist to help bring new environments, props, and gameplay assets to life while maintaining the distinctive visual style that players love. In this role, you’ll work closely with our Art Lead and game team to create performant, high-quality assets that ship to a live game at massive scale.

If you enjoy building stylized game worlds, iterating quickly, and seeing your work experienced by millions of players, this is an opportunity to have a direct impact on one of Roblox’s biggest games.

What You’ll Do

  • Create high-quality 3D assets for Brookhaven, including houses, props, tools, and environmental elements.

  • Iterate on assets based on feedback to ensure they meet the visual quality and gameplay needs of the project.

Who You Are

  • Professional experience in 3D art, game development, or equivalent freelance/personal projects.

  • Creative instincts and the ability to elevate assets visually while respecting technical constraints.

Nice to Have

  • Technical art experience (animation, rigging, VFX).
  • Experience with broader asset pipelines or procedural workflows.

Tech Stack

You may use some or all of the following tools:

  • Roblox Studio

  • Photoshop or equivalent
  • Marmoset Toolbag
  • ZBrush or equivalent

Location

Voldex is an equal opportunity employer. Benefits
