title: DevOps Engineer - São Paulo Based
description:
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider, delivering global connectivity solutions to enterprises and consumers. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform - including its own owned and operated global mobile core network, fully fledged in-house developed eSIM technology, and an extensive portfolio of telecom licenses - 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider across 40 countries worldwide.

We serve many of the world's leading banks, enterprises, and digital-first businesses, including neo-banks, global fast moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally , enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.

1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast-growing business. With full-year revenues in 2025 exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million , we generate strong cash flows to fund our growth allowing us to continuously invest in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in our journey, with major enterprise and mass-consumer client wins accelerating our evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose-built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own aspirations to offer telecommunications services to their clients.

Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs, Hakan KoçandPyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications . We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.

About the Team

We are looking for a talented DevOps Engineer with a focus on Cloud and On-prem infrastructure to join our Technology Department.

About the Role

As a DevOps Engineer, you will design, deploy, and manage our runtime infrastructure, ensuring it is secure, scalable, and cost-efficient. You will plan and implement our container orchestration and service mesh architecture, maintain multi-account AWS Organisation setups, and automate tasks to eliminate human intervention in repetitive processes. Your role includes regular system monitoring, performing maintenance, managing software patches and upgrades, and ensuring optimal observability and performance of systems and applications. You will also investigate and resolve infrastructure issues and create comprehensive documentation for peers and users.

  • Design, deploy, and operate our runtime infrastructure.
  • Plan and create the vision for our container orchestration and service mesh architecture.
  • Design, deploy and maintain multi-account AWS Organisation architecture.
  • Think about scale, reliability, and cost efficiency for our infrastructure.
  • Maintain optimal observability on system and application availability and performance (logs, metrics, alerts).
  • Attain optimal levels of security and scalability.
  • Automate all routine work (toil), eliminating human intervention from repetitive mechanical activity.
  • Perform regular maintenance and housekeeping, verifying the integrity and availability of all hardware resources, systems, and processes, as well as the successful completion of any automated jobs (e.g., config backups, disaster recovery).
  • Perform regular system monitoring, verifying the integrity and availability of all runtime infrastructure.
  • Rollout software patches and upgrades, ensuring the infrastructure is kept secure and compliant with best practices.
  • Investigate issues to their root cause and resolution.
  • Create and maintain the relevant documentation for peers and users (e.g. handbooks, tutorials).

Requirements

  • A minimum of 3 years as a DevOps Engineer or in a similar role.
  • Expertise in AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, VPC, etc.) and managing AWS Organisation and accounts.
  • Experience with on-premises infrastructure and its integration with cloud services.
  • Proficiency in containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, EKS).
  • Experience with Helm for managing Kubernetes applications and service mesh technologies, specifically Istio.
  • GitOps experience including knowledge of tools like Argo CD, Crossplane, GitLab, etc.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform and Terragrunt.
  • Experience with configuration management tools like Ansible, Packer.
  • Experience with virtualised environments based on VMware ESXi is a plus.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools like Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, Loki, and Grafana.
  • Strong experience with programming/scripting languages (Go, Python, Bash).
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex systems.
  • Knowledge of security best practices and compliance standards.

Benefits

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work.
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements.
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day.
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company.
  • Extended parental leave — 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave.
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child.
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin).

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities : Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure : Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team : From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment : Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development : Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience : Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture : Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude : Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.

Job Purpose

The Electrical Engineer is responsible for supporting the safe and reliable operation of electrical systems onboard the FPSO, contributing to performance improvement, asset integrity, and operational efficiency.   • Previous experience in offshore operations (FPSO or oil & gas environment preferred);

title: Network Solution Architect - Data and Voice - São Paulo/Rio de Janeiro Based
description:
About Us

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider, delivering global connectivity solutions to enterprises and consumers. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform — including its own owned and operated global mobile core network, fully fledged in-house developed eSIM technology, and an extensive portfolio of telecom licenses — 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider across 40 countries worldwide.

We serve many of the world's leading banks, enterprises, and digital-first businesses, including neo-banks, global fast moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally , enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.

1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast-growing business. With full-year revenues in 2025 exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million , we generate strong cash flows to fund our growth, allowing us to continuously invest in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in our journey, with major enterprise and mass-consumer client wins accelerating our evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose-built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own aspirations to offer telecommunications services to their clients.

Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications . We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.

About the Team

As an Architect inside the Network Engineering department, you will act as a Solution Architect for new products, services and technologies in 1GLOBAL, acting as a point of contact towards internal and external customers. Effectively work closely with Product and Marketing, but also with all different technical stakeholders and vendors, in shaping, designing, testing, and implementing new solutions. The Architect is responsible for leading the requirements analysis process, in close contact with all relevant stakeholders, to a refined and clear scope, allowing a solution to be created, documented and planned to be implemented.

We are open to hiring for this position in São Paulo, Brazil. The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe's most dynamic and renowned cities.

About the Role

  • Iterates with the customer (internal and external) and other stakeholders to determine technical requirements, risks, technical impacts, and recommendations
  • Designs new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Collaborates with technical teams in defining reliable, modular, scalable, and customer-centric solutions, as well as planning and reviewing solutions
  • Designs and presents solutions in documents and workshops. For the solution, identifies the impacts, efforts and resources needed
  • Market prospection of new solutions through elaboration and analysis of Request for Information/Proposal/Quotation processes and negotiation with potential suppliers
  • Follows up on new technology trends in the telecom industry and identifies interesting solutions for the product portfolio
  • Definition and follow up of company technological evolution roadmaps
  • Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and/or alternatives
  • Ensures and controls quality of documentation execution (HLDs, LLDs, WOs, etc.)
  • Ensures and controls implementation quality. Understands End to End system testing requirements
  • Ensures the network is compliant with industry standards and regulations
  • Capacity and performance analysis, reporting and improvement solution definition
  • Works on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and address design issues for future products or technologies. Enhances, simplifies, and optimizes existing applications and processes
  • Evolves the engineering maturity to be on par with the non-functional and functional state-of-the-art
  • Communicates transparently to the whole business
  • Reaches out to other teams and works towards alignment and overall continuous improvement

Requirements

About You

Must-haves

  • Excellent understanding of Mobile Networks and their architectures
  • Experience with MVNO architectures and landscape. Familiar with roaming environment, including its technical, commercial and regulatory aspects
  • Solid knowledge of networking principles and protocols, including security
  • Experience in network protocols like MAP, CAMEL, SIGTRAN, DIAMETER, SIP
  • Knowledge and experience of OCS and Gy/Sy interfaces
  • Experience with VoLTE and VoWiFi
  • Experience with LTE, 5G, IMS, IP technologies and protocols
  • Familiar with cloud-based solutions and virtualization technologies
  • High Level Designs and Low Level Designs. Experience developing and presenting internal and external documents
  • Experience with 5G Core Mobile Networks
  • Experience with monitoring tools and protocols in Mobile Networks
  • Anticipates problems and addresses them before they cause impact
  • Understands how big-picture goals inform technical details and vice-versa
  • Ability to work in complex environments (multicultural/multi-country/geographically distributed teams)
  • High attention to detail. Doesn't leave things to be addressed or left undone
  • Business oriented, able to engage and discuss with non-technical persons to create technical requirements
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • English proficiency mandatory; other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with cloud applications monitoring and analytics is a plus
  • Experience with AI/ML cloud-based service assurance is a plus
  • Extensive working experience in telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks

Benefits

What we offer?

  • CLT contract — job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses — to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Extended parental leave — 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)!

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

title: Engineering Manager, MAAS
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager as we expand the MAAS team. Our mission with MAAS ("Metal as a Service") is to provide the best solution for building and running private bare-metal infrastructure, putting a cloud-style on-demand API in front of physical server provisioning, network configuration, and storage. We\'re hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality software development and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux on physical servers, Linux storage and data center networking capabilities.

The Canonical MAAS team is responsible for delivering our Metal As A Service (MAAS) hyperscale provisioning technology. Ubuntu strives to be the most scalable, cloud ready server distribution and MAAS is our platform to get Ubuntu on bare metal servers. MAAS is a rapidly evolving software stack written in Python and Go. Its components span the entire software stack: from low-level hardware detection and provisioning, to the upper level management web interface, API, and CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.

Canonical is seeking passionate technical leaders who are eager to drive innovation in one of Canonical’s flagship data center products. You will play a key role in reshaping the future of data center technology through open source management platforms. MAAS aims to revolutionize data center management at scale starting from day zero deployment to long term data center expansion and maintenance.

Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence team and company culture, facilitate technical delivery, and guide strategy and execution. In addition to these responsibilities, you will be expected to collaborate across engineering. The MAAS team regularly interfaces with teams responsible for cloud-init, LXD, and our public cloud offerings.

The successful candidate will have technical leadership attributes and can demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems.

Location : This is a work-from-anywhere position available in EMEA or the Americas.

The role entails

  • Leading a distributed team of engineers in your time zone (we organise engineering teams by Americas, EMEA etc)
  • Talent development through coaching, mentoring, feedback and career planning
  • Setting and managing expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Being an advocate of, and advancing, modern software development practices
  • Participating in the engineering process through code and architectural review
  • Engaging with broader teams at Canonical, the open source community and partners
  • Travelling to internal and external global events for 4 to 6 weeks per year

What we are looking for in you

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) and a background in Computer Science
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Experience with Linux system administration (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Familiarity with modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8S
  • Technical aptitude for understanding complex distributed systems
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with agile software development methodologies
  • Ability to mentor, develop, and support team members
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills

  • Typescript using modern web frameworks such as React, Angular, Svelte or Vue
  • Data Center infrastructure management and design

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we\'ve been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

title: Senior Estimator
description:
Overview

The Senior Estimator uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the estimating discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the estimating discipline. The Senior Estimator solves complex problems and uses their discipline-specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Estimator impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the estimating team and other related teams and ensures that they are working within the appropriate guidelines and policies.

Responsibilities

  • Review, query, and understand the scope of work in order to prepare a proper estimate
  • Gather information and input from functions with support from the project manager
  • Consult with Subject Matter Expert (SME) to discuss Estimates and resolve issues
  • Generate estimates with available Benchmark data and from experience prior to receiving the inputs from functions and evaluate the estimates received from functions against the internal estimate
  • Analyze the cost components that are critical/crucial and seek quotes for applicable items
  • Participate in Bid review meetings, estimate evaluation meetings, Risk assessment meetings, as well as any additional bid-related meetings, as required
  • Prepare a comprehensive Basis of Estimate (BOE)
  • Review and identify contract price form
  • Understand and clarify unit rate and lump sum breakdowns

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering is a plus
  • 5+ years of experience in a large Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) company (preferably in estimating, project controls, and data analytics)

About Us

Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.

For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.

title: TECNICO SEGURANÇA DO TRABALHO
description:
Descrição da vaga

A Leve Saúde é uma operadora de saúde carioca que nasceu com o propósito de transformar a forma como o cuidado em saúde é oferecido no Brasil. Acreditamos que cuidar vai muito além de oferecer planos — é construir relações, escutar de verdade e estar presente na jornada de cada pessoa.

Desde o início, apostamos em um modelo mais próximo, acolhedor e resolutivo. Com equipes próprias e rede integrada, promovemos uma experiência de saúde mais leve, eficiente e centrada no paciente. Nosso ecossistema tecnológico é robusto, baseado em sistemas core de alta complexidade (Solus como ERP, Tasy como Prontuário Eletrônico e Salesforce como plataforma central de CRM e Atendimento), todos integrados por um moderno Barramento de Serviços na AWS seguindo a arquitetura API-LED.

O que nos move:

  • Tornar o cuidado em saúde mais humano e acessível.
  • Reduzir burocracias e facilitar o acesso a serviços de qualidade.
  • Usar a tecnologia como aliada para melhorar a experiência e os resultados em saúde.
  • Como fazemos isso:
  • Com clínicas próprias, prontas para atender com acolhimento e eficiência.
  • Com uma equipe multidisciplinar que acompanha de perto a jornada dos beneficiários.
  • Com um time interno comprometido com inovação, qualidade e propósito.

A responsabilidade envolve promover e garantir a saúde e segurança dos colaboradores por meio da implementação, monitoramento e melhoria contínua das práticas de Segurança e Saúde no Trabalho (SST). Este profissional atuará na identificação de riscos, desenvolvimento de ações preventivas, cumprimento da legislação vigente e apoio às áreas internas, sendo desejável experiência prévia no setor de saúde suplementar (operadoras de planos de saúde, clínicas, hospitais ou empresas do segmento).

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar inspeções em ambientes, instalações e equipamentos, identificando condições inseguras e propondo ações preventivas.
  • Elaborar, implementar e acompanhar programas de Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho, como PGR, LTCAT, AET , entre outros.
  • Investigar e analisar acidentes e incidentes, identificando causas e propondo medidas corretivas e preventivas.
  • Conduzir treinamentos de segurança, integrações, DDS (Diálogo Diário de Segurança) e campanhas educativas de prevenção.
  • Controlar, orientar e fiscalizar o uso correto de EPIs e EPCs .
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos, indicadores e estatísticas de acidentes, acompanhando resultados e planos de ação.
  • Acompanhar perícias, auditorias e fiscalizações, prestando suporte técnico e emitindo CAT quando necessário.
  • Manter atualizada a documentação legal e os registros obrigatórios de SST.
  • Apoiar ações relacionadas à ergonomia, saúde ocupacional e prevenção de riscos psicossociais.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Curso Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho completo.
  • Registro ativo no MTE .
  • Conhecimento e domínio das Normas Regulamentadoras (NRs) e investigação de acidentes.
  • Experiência com gestão de riscos e programas de SST (PGR/GRO ).
  • Conhecimento em legislação trabalhista, previdenciária, RDC e normas de Vigilância Sanitária .
  • Domínio do Pacote Office .
  • Experiência com sistemas de gestão de SST.
  • Experiência prévia na área da saúde suplementar será considerada um diferencial importante.

Salário: pretensão

️ Vale Refeição: R$ 42,00 por dia (desconto simbólico de R$ 1,00/mês)

Analista de Comportamento e Experiência do Consumidor | Marketing

Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Somos uma área estratégica responsável por transformar dados em decisões. Atuamos na análise de performance de campanhas e eventos, no desenvolvimento de soluções de Business Intelligence e na geração de insights sobre comportamento, jornada e experiência do consumidor, apoiando a liderança na tomada de decisões.

A área tem forte interface com tecnologia, dados e negócios, sendo responsável por relatórios executivos, dashboards e estudos analíticos sobre comportamento e jornada do consumidor, que impactam diretamente os resultados da companhia.

  • Analisar interações do consumidor com diferentes iniciativas da companhia (CRM, benefícios, promoções, eventos e ações de marketing);

  • Conduzir estudos de mercado, análises de tendências e benchmarking;
  • Estruturar análises, relatórios executivos e apresentações para a diretoria.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, raciocínio lógico e pensamento estruturado;
  • Domínio avançado de Power BI (mandatório), incluindo modelagem de dados, DAX e dashboards interativos;
  • Conhecimento sólido em Excel e Pacote Office;
  • Habilidade para cruzar diferentes bases de dados e transformar informação em insights.

title: Assistant Registrar
description:
Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth. Here is what we offer:

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us! Benefits:

JOB PURPOSE

Responsible for the management, planning, and coordination of course scheduling, maintaining student academic records and graduation activities and services. In that capacity, the position oversees program operation, and performs all related administrative duties.

SUPERVISORY AUTHORITY

Student Workers

NATURE AND SCOPE

Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, staff and students. External contacts include, Associate/Assistant Registrars, University Registrar or designee, coordinators, visitors, alumni and the general public.

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Organizes, maintains, administers and digitizes student academic records for MSW and doctoral programs.
  • Generates and prepares a variety of academic and enrollment data reports to support the forecasting of future schedules, planning, program management, and accreditation.
  • Oversees the academic requirements for graduation.
  • Troubleshoots and resolves registration errors on behalf of students and faculty.
  • Develops and updates class schedules for each semester.
  • Monitors class enrollment for each semester.
  • Notifies students regarding their academic standing and other academic requirements.
  • Keeps student information confidential and secure.
  • Participates in student service committees and initiatives.
  • Develops and implements procedures to ensure the integrity of student records.
  • Performs regular audits on academic records and transcripts.
  • Manages all administrative processes and activites/programs related to each graduation cycle
  • Supports school-wide programs and activities
  • Researches and responds to student inquiries.
  • Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

CORE COMPETENCIES

  • In-depth knowledge of registrar-related activities
  • Demonstrated organizational skills
  • Ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing
  • Strong computer literacy, with database development and management experience
  • Ability to devise solutions to administrative problems.
  • Ability to maintain the confidentiality of information.
  • Ability to work effectively and harmoniously with students, faculty, staff, University officials and the general public.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor\'s degree in related field such as criminal Justice, social work, law
  • Three to five years’ experience in Higher education preferred or related field.
  • Working knowledge of Title IX, Clery Act, and other federal and state impacts on the work of student conduct administration and higher education.
  • Demonstrated strong verbal, written, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to manage competing tasks and prioritize work in a dynamic environment.
  • Desired in addition to minimum requirements:
  • Experience working with faculty, staff and students and an ability to navigate complex systems.
  • Ability to facilitate trainings, do student programming and outreach
  • Understanding of student development theory and ability to translate into practice of student conduct administration.
  • Experience adjudicating student conduct violations in either a university level setting or a Residence Life and Housing setting.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$50,000-$60,000

title: RECEPCIONISTA - CLÍNICA TIJUCA
description:
Descrição da vaga

A Leve Saúde é uma operadora de saúde carioca que nasceu com o propósito de transformar a forma como o cuidado em saúde é oferecido no Brasil . Acreditamos que cuidar vai muito além de oferecer planos — é construir relações, escutar de verdade e estar presente na jornada de cada pessoa.

Desde o início, apostamos em um modelo mais próximo, acolhedor e resolutivo. Com equipes próprias e rede integrada, promovemos uma experiência de saúde mais leve, eficiente e centrada no paciente.

O que nos move:

  • Tornar o cuidado em saúde mais humano e acessível.
  • Reduzir burocracias e facilitar o acesso a serviços de qualidade.
  • Usar a tecnologia como aliada para melhorar a experiência e os resultados em saúde.

Como fazemos isso:

  • Com clínicas próprias, prontas para atender com acolhimento e eficiência.
  • Com uma equipe multidisciplinar que acompanha de perto a jornada dos beneficiários.
  • Com um time interno comprometido com inovação, qualidade e propósito.

Somos uma empresa em constante crescimento, e cada colaborador é parte essencial dessa construção. Aqui dentro, acreditamos em colaboração, em diálogo e no poder de fazer diferente.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Receber os pacientes com empatia, cordialidade e atenção desde a chegada à clínica;
  • Realizar o acolhimento inicial, identificando necessidades e oferecendo suporte personalizado;
  • Orientar sobre procedimentos, horários, documentos e fluxo da clínica;
  • Esclarecer dúvidas sobre consultas, exames, encaminhamentos e demais serviços;
  • Realizar autorização de guias junto a operadoras de saúde (via sistemas como TISS ou plataformas específicas);
  • Efetuar o recebimento de atendimentos particulares, incluindo emissão de recibos e controle de pagamentos;
  • Acompanhar o paciente durante sua jornada, garantindo conforto e tranquilidade;
  • Após a consulta, verificar como foi a experiência e oferecer suporte adicional, se necessário;
  • Atuar como ponte entre paciente e equipe médica/administrativa, promovendo comunicação clara;
  • Receber e organizar documentos, correspondências e resultados de exames;
  • Auxiliar em tarefas administrativas como preenchimento de fichas, arquivamento e atualização de cadastros;
  • Manter a recepção limpa, organizada e funcional.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo (superior em áreas da saúde, humanas ou hospitalidade é um diferencial);
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escuta ativa;
  • Postura acolhedora, empática e proativa;
  • Experiência com atendimento ao público, preferencialmente em ambientes de saúde;
  • Capacidade de lidar com situações delicadas com sensibilidade e discrição.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com atendimento humanizado;
  • Conhecimento do sistema Tasy;
  • Conhecimento básico em sistemas de gestão ambulatorial;
  • Participação em treinamentos de hospitalidade ou experiência do cliente.

Informações adicionais

  • Vale Refeição: R$42,00/dia (com desconto simbólico de R$1,00/mês)
  • Vale Transporte
  • Day Off no dia do aniversário
  • Plano de Saúde (sem desconto em folha)
  • Plano Odontológico (sem desconto em folha)
  • Total Pass (bem-estar e atividade física)
  • Descontos com instituições de ensino
  • Universidade Corporativa Leve

title: Drilling Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation PackageJob
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat relocation package.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Drilling Engineer to join the Gas Drilling Engineering Department.

The Gas Drilling Engineering Department is responsible for providing the development of gas drilling and workover engineering with non-associated gas and highly complex horizontal and vertical gas wells. Identifying and introducing innovations that enhance monitor and support operation and safety.

Your primary role is to gather and analyze information to provide sound drilling technical support to drilling operations, drilling equipment, projects and drilling technical services requiring sound drilling engineering analysis and solutions.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Provides sound drilling engineering methods and procedures to be used on assigned drilling problems.
  • Executes and accomplishes assignments and studies in areas outlined in the scope assuring conformance to overall objectives of all phases of drilling operations in areas including: drilling penetration rate optimization, new drilling technology and drilling studies.
  • Provides technical assistance and advice to operating divisions on complex operating problems.
  • Initiates detailed work outlines and performs or delegates work for final development of technical proposals and studies of proposed.
  • Analyzes data and performance of new or existing techniques to determine need for or benefit from studies, recommendations and/or facility modifications with respect to unit costs and operating efficiency consistent with established safety and operating requirements.

As the successful candidate you will hold a:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Petroleum, Mechanical or Chemical Engineering or related Engineering discipline from an accredited university.
  • 7+ years of experience in drilling field.

Working environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

#J-18808-Ljbffr

title: SUPERVISOR DESMOBILIZAÇÃO - Rio de Janeiro / RJ
description:
Descrição da vaga

A Unidas, integrante do grupo Brookfield, é uma das maiores empresas do setor de mobilidade no Brasil. Conta com cerca de 100 mil ativos entre veículos leves, caminhões, máquinas e equipamentos pesados, e oferece uma plataforma completa de soluções de gestão e locação de veículos, operações e manutenção, trazendo economia e praticidade para pessoas e empresas em todo o país. Conta também com mais de 200 lojas entre aluguel de carros e venda de seminovos, incluindo leves e pesados, no varejo e atacado. A companhia, que tem mais de 4 mil colaboradores, é reconhecida como uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil pelo ranking Great Place to Work. Além disso, foi eleita como a 32ª marca mais valiosa pelo Brand Finance Brazil e, por sete vezes, conquistou o Prêmio Consumidor Moderno de Excelência em Serviço ao Cliente na categoria “Locadora de veículos”. Empoderamos as pessoas do nosso time e investimos no aprendizado diário e desenvolvimento contínuo. Aqui, cada Unilover é responsável por sua carreira e a leva para onde quiser. Deu match com o nosso jeito de ser? #VemPraUnidas

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Planejar e supervisionar as atividades de desmobilização em contratos encerrados ou redimensionados, garantindo execução dentro do cronograma.
  • Coordenar a retirada de veículos, máquinas e equipamentos nos clientes, assegurando logística eficiente e transporte adequado.
  • Supervisionar ou realizar vistorias, checklists e registros fotográficos dos ativos desmobilizados.
  • Garantir a integridade física dos ativos durante o transporte e no retorno à base ou nova alocação.
  • Apoiar as áreas Comercial e de Contratos no processo de encerramento operacional dos contratos de locação.
  • Supervisionar equipes próprias e terceiros envolvidos na retirada e transporte dos ativos.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das normas de segurança, legislação de trânsito e boas práticas ambientais.
  • Garantir a rastreabilidade documental de todo o processo de desmobilização, incluindo laudos, relatórios e registros em sistema.
  • Manter relacionamento com clientes, fornecedores de transporte, oficinas e demais parceiros envolvidos.
  • Participar de reuniões de encerramento de contrato, contribuindo com análises, lições aprendidas e sugestões de melhoria contínua.

Requisitos e qualificações

Formação Acadêmica

  • Superior completo em Logística, Administração, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência

  • Vivência com gestão de frotas, logística de veículos, locação de frotas ou operações de campo.
  • Experiência com processos de mobilização/desmobilização de contratos.

Conhecimentos Técnicos

  • Logística de transporte e controle de frotas.
  • Vistorias, checklists e documentação veicular.
  • Conhecimento de manutenção preventiva e corretiva.
  • Ferramentas de controle e sistemas (Excel, ERPs como TOTVS, sistemas de rastreamento).

Competências Comportamentais Desejadas

  • Liderança e gestão de equipes.
  • Organização e planejamento.
  • Foco em resultados.
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Capacidade de resolução de problemas.
  • Atenção a detalhes e comprometimento com qualidade.

Informações adicionais

  • Convênio Médico
  • Convênio Odontológico
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale Transporte
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Alimentação
  • Cartão Farmácia
  • WellHub
  • Clube de Vantagens
  • Cartão flex
  • Programa de Lucros e Resultados

Na Unidas, acreditamos que carreira é jornada , não destino . Somos um dos maiores grupos do Brasil no setor de mobilidade e terceirização de frotas , com soluções completas que vão de veículos leves a pesados, passando por máquinas e equipamentos. Mas o que realmente nos move são as pessoas .

Somos um time que se movimenta em um único sentido: simplificar a vida dos nossos clientes com soluções completas, inovação em aluguel de ativos e serviços confiáveis . Esse é o nosso destino — e a nossa cultura é o veículo que nos leva até lá.

Valorizamos o desenvolvimento contínuo , o aprendizado diário e o empoderamento individual . Acreditamos que cada talento tem o poder de transformar realidades — e oferecemos as ferramentas, o ambiente e os desafios certos para isso acontecer.

Com Mais De 50 Anos De História, Presença Em Todo o Brasil e Mais De 120 Mil Ativos Em Operação, a Unidas é Feita De Movimento, Crescimento e Transformação. Atuamos Com Excelência Em Diversas Frentes

  • Unidas Aluguel de Carros: mobilidade sob medida para pessoas e empresas.
  • Unidas Livre: assinatura de veículos 0km com praticidade e liberdade.
  • Unidas Frotas: gestão inteligente de frotas leves e pesadas.
  • Unidas Pesados: soluções robustas para os setores agrícola, de mineração e construção.
  • Unidas Seminovos: veículos com procedência e ótimo custo-benefício.

POR QUE ESCOLHER A UNIDAS PARA SUA CARREIRA?

  • Cultura de protagonismo e colaboração.
  • Programas de desenvolvimento e capacitação.
  • Ambiente que valoriza a diversidade e inclusão.
  • Desafios reais com impacto direto nos negócios.
  • Oportunidades em diferentes regiões e áreas de atuação.

FAZEMOS PARTE DE ALGO MAIOR.

A Unidas integra o portfólio da Brookfield Asset Management, uma das maiores gestoras de ativos do mundo, com visão de longo prazo e compromisso com o desenvolvimento sustentável.

✨ Deu match com o nosso jeito de ser e busca um lugar onde possa crescer, aprender, inovar e fazer parte de uma história de transformação, a Unidas é o seu caminho certo .

Aqui, sua carreira tem direção, propósito e movimento.

description:
Descrição da vaga

RED BALLOON

Queremos expandir o mundo de cada estudante cultivando o fascínio pelo aprendizado em inglês.

Há 55 anos, nos dedicamos a tornar a jornada de aprendizado de crianças e adolescentes inesquecível. Enquanto eles se divertem, aprendem a falar, ouvir, ler e escrever em inglês de verdade.

Mais do que isso, se envolvem e se abrem para novos aprendizados: se expressar, colaborar e interagir com os outros, colocar suas ideias com confiança e respeito, improvisar e criar.

Ensinamos com afeto em um ambiente que encanta e acende a curiosidade. Nos dedicamos a compreender cada fase da infância e da adolescência e acompanhamos os estudantes de forma especial.

Red Balloon - Inglês para voar alto!

title: Agentic Engineer - CAB LATAM
description:
About Wati

Started as a WhatsApp team inbox in 2020, Wati has evolved into a full revenue orchestration system that goes beyond a single platform. We empower businesses that sell, support, and grow through conversations by observing customer intent in real-time, deciding the next best revenue action, and executing it seamlessly across marketing, sales, and support—all within WhatsApp and connected messaging channels.

Our Platform & AI Capabilities

Wati is designed for scalability and intelligence. Our AI-native platform simplifies complex customer communication operations through a unified inbox, a robust multi-channel messaging infrastructure, and no-code automation. At the heart of our solution is Astra, our intelligent AI layer, which helps you create AI Agents for all customer interactions and all your messaging platforms. By integrating AI agents into the ecosystem, we enable businesses of all sizes to deliver measurable ROI and build deeper customer relationships.

Our Backing & Partnerships

Trusted by over 16,000 customers across 190+ countries, Wati is proudly backed by world‑class investors including Tiger Global, Sequoia Capital, DST Global, and Shopify. As a Premium‑tier Partner of Meta and Google, we maintain the highest standards of platform excellence and integration.

About the Role

We are looking for an Agentic Engineer to join our Customer Advisory Board (CAB) team in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The CAB team is dedicated to building tailored, custom solutions for our most valuable clients in the LATAM region. In this role, you will lead Wati’s regional custom engineering efforts, working closely with clients, product managers, and regional teams to translate complex, customized business requirements into scalable engineering solutions. You will combine strong engineering execution with a deep understanding of the local market, building API integrations, automating workflows, and shipping bespoke features that directly solve our clients' unique challenges in Brazil and across Latin America. This role requires someone who is highly adaptable, execution‑oriented, and comfortable operating at the intersection of core engineering and client‑facing customized delivery.

What You Will Do

  • Lead engineering initiatives to design, build, and deploy custom features and workflows tailored to the specific needs of Wati's key clients in the LATAM market
  • Partner directly with the CAB team and regional stakeholders to deeply understand bespoke client requirements and translate them into robust technical architectures
  • Develop seamless integrations between Wati's platform and local LATAM third‑party systems, CRMs, ERPs, and payment gateways commonly used by our Brazilian and regional clients
  • Ensure the high reliability, security, and scalability of custom‑built solutions, maintaining Wati's standard of excellence even in highly specialized enterprise environments
  • Iterate rapidly on custom deployments, troubleshooting client‑specific technical issues and providing engineering support for critical LATAM accounts
  • Continuously improve internal tooling and frameworks to accelerate the delivery speed of custom client solutions
  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering, preferably in B2B SaaS, enterprise software, or custom solutions development
  • Proven experience building scalable API integrations and working with complex system architectures to meet specific enterprise client needs
  • Native or bilingual proficiency in Portuguese and professional working proficiency in English and Spanish
  • Strong problem‑solving mindset, with the ability to manage multiple custom projects simultaneously and adapt to changing client requirements
  • Strong product and business intuition, with the ability to connect engineering work to real client business impact
  • AI‑native mindset, actively using AI tools or AI agents in development workflows

description:
Multi Site Environmental Manager, Environmental Assurance and Protection (EAP)

Brazil's Environmental Assurance and Protection (EAP) team is seeking a Multi Site Environmental Manager (MSEM) to support our Amazon Operations. This role supports multiple sites. The MSEM will develop standards and policies to support regulatory compliance as well as partner with operations leadership teams for execution of these standards and policies, to ensure compliance with all applicable county/locations specific Federal, State and local laws and regulations. The MSEM travels greater than 50% of the time.

Key job responsibilities

  • Manage and execute multi site responsibilities to comply with stormwater, waste, wastewater and other environmental related laws, regulations and permits. This includes required Federal, State and local reporting.
  • Manage and execute business conformance with Amazon EAP Management Systems Policies. Develop Amazon Geo-Specific Operational Environmental Procedures by integrating with engineering, construction and operations.
  • Lead regulatory agency interactions, permit evaluation and processing, and new process and technology introduction.
  • Primary point of contact for environmental regulatory agencies and represents Amazon at appropriate levels with governmental agencies and throughout the company.
  • Ensure work performed by contractors, consultants, and employees is completed in accordance with regulatory requirements and Amazon standards.
  • Monitor environmental metrics to review trends to determine where improvements are needed.
  • Conduct thorough and accurate environmental inspections and audits for continuous improvement.
  • Prioritize and manage multiple, technically complex assignments, concurrently.
  • Build and manage collaborative relationships with various stakeholders to ensure risks are identified early and managed appropriately.
  • Compile and submit time critical reports to various governmental agencies.
  • Complete thorough and accurate environmental incident investigations and associated regulatory reports, and develop appropriate corrective actions.
  • Ensure site leadership and associates are trained and knowledgeable of their responsibilities under each policy.

A day in the life

The MSEM will complete environmental performance analysis, establish and monitor metrics, and guide the operations leadership teams in implementation of Amazon environmental standards. The MSEM will work with internal and external partners that include government entities, contractors, consultants, design, construction, operations and other key stakeholders.

About the team

The EAP organization protects Amazon businesses and supports the needs of our customers by proactively mitigating environmental regulatory risks and protecting the environment.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in the Environmental Sciences, Environmental Engineering, or related field
  • Experience developing and implementing environmental compliance programs including regulated waste, water, and air regulations in accordance with applicable laws
  • Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience engaging with regulatory agencies in permit applications or equivalent
  • Experience in environmental compliance and permitting, waste management, contractual, regulatory, and liability assessments, environmental permit evaluations and applications, EIAs and water discharge requirements
  • Knowledge of Brazilian state and federal environmental regulations

Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com a equipe de planejamento para alinhar estratégias e compartilhar informações importantes;
  • Manter registros precisos e atualizados de todas as interações com leads e clientes no sistema de CRM;
  • Participar de treinamentos e workshops para aprimorar habilidades de vendas e manter-se atualizado sobre produtos e serviços;
  • Análise do desempenho dos clientes, interação com os times técnicos, marketing e conteúdo para ações de relacionamento.

Requisitos e qualificações

E o que você precisa ter?

  • Perfil comercial para captação de clientes, Visitas presenciais, abordagem ativa, PAP
  • Disponibilidades para viagens de carro, ônibus ou avião, de acordo com a região de atuação;

  • Disposição para se adaptar a mudanças nas estratégias de vendas ou no mercado.

No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.

title: Regional BDR Team Manager
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are expanding our sales and field engineering teams globally, including our sales development representative (SDR) teams. Our SDRs are typically outstanding graduates from STEM fields who would like to join the software industry and are starting their sales career at Canonical.

We are hiring SDR Team Managers to run new inbound and outbound teams. Our goal is not only to manage inbound leads for a global tech company, but also to develop outstanding sales professionals with high integrity, high empathy and a rigorous work ethic. Our sales development organisation is therefor also sales academy, and as such, we are looking for SDR Team Managers who take a strong interest in the development of skills and the establishment of culture.

You will enjoy this role if you are organised, persistent, analytical, hard-working, and care to ensure that smart and ambitious people learn and develop the skills they need to represent you and the company in outstandingly well over the course of their career - both while they are on your team, and as they move onward to more senior sales and alliances positions. You should be determined to grow your own skills as well as those of your team, and enjoy learning about new technologies. Canonical is fortunate to represent the vast wave of open source innovation, which means it has a large and rapidly growing range of solutions it can deliver to customers, and ample opportunity for all of us to learn about new kinds of tech, or specialise in fields we enjoy the most. You should also be open to innovation, and experiment with new outbound approaches to adapt to changes in the market. In this role your primary objective is to manage and mentor a successful team of 2-10 SDRs / BDRs, and maintain a multi‑million dollar pipeline.

We value:

  • Excellent academic results at school and university
  • Bachelor's or equivalent degree in Business or STEM
  • Knowledge and passion for business development, sales and technology
  • Track record of bringing exceptional outbound sales development results
  • Commitment to continuous learning and improvement – curious, flexible, scientific
  • Creative problem solving and cross team collaboration
  • Leadership experience of one form or another
  • Able to use data to drive team activities and continuous improvement

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance‑driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Corporate Communications Senior Manager
description:
Corporate Communications Senior Manager

Department: Communications

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Corporate Communications Senior Manager will lead strategic planning and delivery of communications and public relations strategies and activities for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, ensuring the tournament is powerfully positioned in line with FIFA’s overall strategic objectives and the FIFA Women’s Football Strategy.

This role is responsible to support the Head of Communications & Media Relations in the rollout and implementation of the Communications components of the tournament’s Marketing & Communications Strategy, with a strong focus on Brazil and South America. The position plays a central role in leading the development and implementation of proactive corporate communications that enhance FIFA’s reputation, raises awareness on the tournament, influences public perception, engages with internal and external stakeholders for higher impact and ensures consistency across proactive and reactive messaging at a global level.

Reporting jointly to the Head of Communications & Media Relations based in Brazil and to the Team Lead Corporate Communications in Switzerland, the Corporate Communications Senior Manager will collaborates with senior stakeholders, decision-makers, and leadership teams to translate corporate priorities and tournament objectives into engaging, credible narratives.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead and implement a corporate communications-first approach, delivering proactive, strategic messaging and storytelling across Brazil and South America in line with the Marketing & Communications Strategy.
  • Develops messaging for tournament milestones, events, initiatives, campaigns, announcements and key FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ functional areas.
  • Act as the central integrator for communications-related matters, coordinating internal and external stakeholders including FIFA27 functional teams, Host City communications teams, federal, state and municipal authorities, the CBF, and other key partners.
  • Develop and implement pre‑emptive communications plans to manage risk, address sensitive topics and engage targeted audiences.
  • Develop issues and crisis communications planning and execution within FIFA27 in close alignment with the FIFA Communications Division, supporting all relevant partners and activities in the lead‑up to and during the tournament.
  • Build close working relationships with other Marketing and Communications teams to ensure narrative unity and operational efficiency.
  • Partner with the Media Relations department to identify and amplify proactive stories that shape public understanding of FIFA’s initiatives.
  • Partner with digital, editorial, and campaign teams to deliver integrated storytelling across FIFA’s ecosystem,
  • Perform other duties directly related to the role, as required by FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ leadership or the FIFA Communications Division.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum 7 years experience in communications, media and public relations, with experience in similar leadership positions
  • Familiarity with the world of football. Passion for women’s football is a plus
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written) and Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Spanish language skills are an asset
  • Able and willing to travel up to 50% of the year
  • Able and willing to work non‑traditional hours including evenings and weekends as needed
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Company Overview

Founded in early 2002, viaPeople set out to redefine the human resources software industry by adopting a unique business model. Unlike competitors that offered one-size-fits-all solutions, we committed to developing best‑of‑breed products tailored to the distinct needs of our clients. Our approach combines expert‑driven design with exceptional flexibility to address even the most complex requirements, all while maintaining a steadfast focus on product excellence, relationship management, and superior service quality.

With over two decades of experience in optimizing people management, viaPeople delivers bespoke HR software solutions that adapt to client needs, supported by a reliable and responsive vendor. Our offerings include performance management, succession planning, and 360‑degree feedback solutions, all backed by an exceptional level of service.

Job Overview

The Business Development Representative (BDR) will be responsible for maintaining and scaling viaPeople’s sales engine. This role sits at the intersection of sales development, lead operations, and sales analytics.

You will own lead ingestion, enrichment, and sourcing efforts while partnering closely with sales leadership to ensure pipeline health, data quality, and visibility into performance. This role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, data‑oriented, and motivated by building systems that enable consistent outbound success.

This is a foundational role on the growth team with clear exposure to sales strategy, tooling, and performance metrics.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Development & Lead Sourcing

  • Own inbound lead intake, qualification, routing, and enrichment
  • Proactively source new leads through research, outbound prospecting, and targeted account lists
  • Support outbound campaigns via email, LinkedIn, and other prospecting tools
  • Identify ideal customer profiles (ICPs) and buying personas in partnership with sales leadership

Sales Operations & Data Integrity

  • Maintain clean, accurate, and enriched CRM data
  • Ensure lead and account records are consistently updated and standardized
  • Track funnel performance from lead to opportunity
  • Identify gaps, bottlenecks, and drop‑off points in the sales process

Reporting & Dashboards

  • Build and maintain sales dashboards and reporting to track
    • Lead volume and source
    • Conversion rates
    • Pipeline coverage
    • Activity metrics
  • Provide regular reporting and insights to sales leadership
  • Support forecasting and pipeline reviews with accurate data

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Sales, Marketing, and Leadership to align on pipeline goals
  • Provide feedback on lead quality and campaign effectiveness
  • Support Account Executives by ensuring qualified, well‑researched leads

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred (or equivalent experience)

  • Strong analytical and organizational skills with attention to detail
  • Experience working with CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar)
  • Comfortable working with spreadsheets, dashboards, and basic reporting
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Self-starter who thrives in a fast‑moving, early‑growth environment
  • Interest in B2B SaaS, HR technology, or sales operations is a plus

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary Range: Competitive Compensation Package
  • Bonus: Performance‑based bonus tied to pipeline and data quality metrics
  • PTO: Generous unlimited PTO and holiday schedule
  • Growth Opportunity: Direct exposure to sales strategy, tooling decisions, and leadership

Why This Role Matters

This role is critical to ensuring viaPeople’s sales team operates with clarity, consistency, and momentum. You’ll help power the front end of the revenue engine while providing the insights leadership needs to scale efficiently.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Estamos buscando umAnalista de Segurança da Informação Sênior que será responsável por atuar como um pilar técnico na execução da estratégia de segurança da informação, sendo responsável por conduzir processos de segurança, implementar e gerenciar tecnologias de proteção, e atuar na linha de frente da análise e resposta a ameaças. O profissional deve ser um generalista, capaz de transitar por diferentes domínios da segurança e garantir a resiliência dos ativos da empresa.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Seus desafios serão:

  • Gestão de Vulnerabilidades: Coordenar o ciclo de vida da gestão de vulnerabilidades, desde a identificação (scans) e priorização até o acompanhamento da remediação junto às equipes de TI e de negócio.
  • Análise de Riscos de Segurança: Conduzir análises de risco em novas tecnologias, projetos e fornecedores, recomendando os controles de segurança necessários para mitigar as ameaças identificadas.
  • Resposta a Incidentes (N2/N3): Atuar na análise e tratamento de incidentes de segurança escalados pelo time de N1, realizando investigações, contendo ameaças e apoiando a recuperação dos sistemas.
  • Implementação de Tecnologias: Participar ativamente de projetos de implementação de novas ferramentas de segurança, como soluções de EDR, DLP, SIEM e segurança em nuvem.
  • Segurança em Nuvem: Apoiar na definição e implementação de controles de segurança para ambientes em nuvem (AWS, Azure), garantindo a conformidade e a proteção dos dados.
  • Automação de Processos (SOAR): Desenvolver e manter playbooks de automação para a orquestração da resposta a incidentes e outras tarefas rotineiras de segurança.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que é necessário você ter:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Conhecimento Técnico Amplo: Experiência prática em áreas como segurança de redes (firewalls, IDS/IPS), segurança de sistemas operacionais (Windows, Linux), e segurança de aplicações.
  • Ferramentas de Segurança: Experiência com ferramentas de SIEM/SOAR, EDR, scanners de vulnerabilidade e soluções de segurança em nuvem.
  • Análise e Resolução de Problemas: Forte capacidade analítica para investigar alertas de segurança, identificar a causa raiz de incidentes e propor soluções eficazes.
  • Colaboração: Habilidade de trabalhar em equipe e de colaborar com outras áreas de TI e de negócio para alcançar os objetivos de segurança.
  • Certificações (Diferencial): Certificações como Security+, CySA+, ou de fornecedores (ex: CCNA Security, Palo Alto, etc.) são um diferencial.

title: Ad Ops Onboarding Manager - Publishers (Remote)
description:
About MonetizeMore

MonetizeMore is a global leader in ad tech, seen by 300M+ people monthly. For 16 years, we’ve achieved double-digit growth by blending proprietary AI technology with manual optimization techniques to empower publishers. We are a culture-centric, location-independent organization that values Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen, and Collaboration.

MonetizeMore offers location and schedule freedom to every one of its team members. That means that you would have the lifestyle autonomy to choose to work from anywhere in the world, during the time of day you prefer. This new-age work lifestyle would enable you to engineer your ideal lifestyle. Say goodbye to endless commutes, stuffy business attire, and the arbitrary 9 to 5 work-day. Take your life back into your hands by joining the MonetizeMore team!

What You’ll Do

As part of our Publisher Centric Team , At M2, we focus and emphasize proactive Publisher Services. As the Onboarding Manager, your role is a critical "first impression" of our organization and our ability to support our publishing partners in reaching their goals.

You will spearhead the onboarding process for new publishers, ensuring they are equipped with the right tech, knowledge, and confidence to succeed. You are not just setting up accounts you are orchestrating a "White Glove" experience that reduces time-to-value and sets the stage for long-term retention. You also pay attention to improving our systems and processes along the way to continuously improve our service to publishers.

Responsibilities

  1. Project Management & Implementation
    • Lead the Lifecycle: Expertly manage the publisher journey from Sales endorsement to "Live" status. You are the project manager for the publisher’s first 30-90 days.
    • Technical Coordination: Collaborate with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers to troubleshoot setup concerns (Header Bidding, GAM, wrappers) and ensure optimal configuration.
    • Feature Activation: Ensure all applicable M2 Tech Features are activated at launch to maximize publisher revenue immediately (KPI: Uptake %).
  2. Client-Centric Communication & Education
    • Kick-off & Strategy: Conduct kick-off calls to understand the publisher's specific business goals and align our implementation plan to meet them.
    • Ambassadorship: Act as the primary champion for M2 tools and products. Provide comprehensive walkthroughs to ensure publishers are comfortable and proficient with our platform.
    • Responsive Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for all questions during installation, providing guidance that is both technical and empathetic.
  3. Performance Analysis & Handoff
    • Performance Reviews: Conduct thorough 7-day and 30-day post-live performance reviews. Use data to demonstrate value and identify early optimization wins.
    • Seamless Transition: Manage a structured handoff to the Ad Optimizer and Customer Success Manager, ensuring no momentum is lost after the initial 30-day period.

Day-today Activities

You are the external face of MonetizeMore for our newest partners. You thrive on variety and high-energy interaction—no two days (or publishers) are exactly alike.

  • External Engagement: You will constantly meet new partners, leading high-impact kickoff calls to align our tech with their specific business goals.
  • Project Command: You project manage the entire implementation lifecycle, coordinating between the publisher and our technical teams to ensure an optimal, revenue-ready setup and accelerated scale.
  • Performance Ownership: You don't just "set it and forget it." You conduct data-driven 7-day and 30-day etc. performance reviews to prove value immediately.
  • Seamless Handoff: Once the foundation is solid, you orchestrate a smooth transfer to the account management team ensuring the relationship momentum continues uninterrupted.

How this role fits into the organization

This is a cornerstone role that is pivotal to our company’s success.

  • Strategic Impact: Reporting to the Ad Ops Team Manager, you are the architect of the "First 30 Days." Since our publishers' growth is our growth, our long-term revenue goals effectively start on your desk.
  • The "Wow" Factor: You are responsible for delivering the "White Glove" experience. You set the trajectory for retention by uncovering publisher goals early and proving that MonetizeMore is a partner, not just a vendor.
  • Bridge Builder: You act as the vital link between Sales promises and long-term Operational success, ensuring that every new client enters our ecosystem with clarity, confidence, and a setup primed for revenue generation.

Who You Are

Must Haves

  • Experience: 1+ years of experience in Programmatic sell-side advertising, Customer Onboarding, or Ad Operations.
  • Technical Knowledge: Understanding of Google Ad Manager (GAM), AdSense, Header Bidding, and Google Analytics. Experience with WordPress and debugging ad calls is a strong plus.
  • Analytical Skills: Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and data presentation tools. You can spot trends in numbers quickly.
  • Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You can command a room (virtually) and manage expectations clearly.
  • Project Management: Demonstrated ability to manage multiple implementations simultaneously without dropping the ball.

Nice to Have

  • Has worked with AdSense, Google Analytics, and GAM and has extensive knowledge of Google policies and other platforms
  • Understands coding and has a strong tech background
  • Has worked with WordPress and is knowledgeable when it comes to implementing ads and debugging ad calls
  • Bilingual - Portuguese and Spanish are an extra bonus

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary : Our salary formula adjusts to your cost of living and experience.
  • Work remotely : Live and work wherever you like!
  • Flexible working hours : You have the autonomy to set your own schedule
  • Retreats : We meet in person for company get-togethers.
  • Career growth and learning opportunities

If you think you are a good fit to join our Ad Optimization , please apply on this side bar and give specific reasons what sets you apart. We hire individuals, not robots so don’t be afraid to show a little personality.

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion. Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

description:
Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil.
